description: Source file implementing transformation and integration logic for the LangGraph API within a language model client framework. Contains classes for configuration, error handling, request/response transformation, and streaming support specific to LangGraph endpoints.

classes.name: LangGraphError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors related to LangGraph API interactions.

classes.name: LangGraphConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing LangGraph API parameters, URL construction, message conversions, request/response transformations, and streaming support.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], )

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters; for LangGraph, primarily 'stream'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps provided openai-style parameters to LangGraph parameters.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )

methods.name: str _get_assistant_id(self, model: str, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Extracts or derives the assistant ID from model name or optional parameters.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] _convert_messages_to_langgraph_format( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues] )
methods.description: Converts list of messages from OpenAI format to LangGraph format.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )

methods.name: str _extract_content_from_response(self, response_json: dict)

methods.name: LangGraphSSEStreamIterator get_streaming_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, )
methods.description: Wraps raw HTTP response in a SSE iterator for streaming.

methods.name: CustomStreamWrapper get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, "AsyncHTTPHandler"]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )

methods.description: Creates an asynchronous custom stream wrapper for streaming responses.

methods.name: bool has_custom_stream_wrapper(self)

methods.name: bool supports_stream_param_in_request_body(self)

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
